== Notes ==
* [[Enduring Harmony]] extends the [[duration]] of this shout to 30 seconds, even at 0 [[Leadership]].
* Often used to fuel and maintain [["Save Yourselves!"]].

;Warrior / Paragon
"For Great Justice!" is a staple skill for [[Paragon]]s and [[Warrior]]s, as these professions tend to rely on adrenaline skills to compensate for their low [[energy regeneration]]. 
* This skill can function as an indirect [[energy management]] tool for Paragons by allowing an increased use of adrenaline-based [[shouts]] and [[chant]]s to trigger [[Leadership]]'s energy gain more often. 
** The shouts [["Go for the Eyes!"]] and [["The Power Is Yours!"]] are in particular effective, as they have low adrenaline costs, no activation time and no [[recharge time]]. 
* Combines very well with [[Dragon Slash]] at 10 or higher [[Swordsmanship]], as the doubled adrenaline gain equals the cost of Dragon Slash itself. This allows the attack skill to be [[spam|used repeatedly]], while also rapidly fueling all other equipped adrenaline skills.

== Trivia ==
* The phrase "for great justice" comes from the English (European) translation of the video game [[wikipedia:Zero_Wing|Zero Wing]], which is also the source of the [["Make Your Time!"]] skill name and the "[[wikipedia:All your base are belong to us|All your base are belong to us]]" meme.
